//: A solo project on GitHub Issues: every ticket gets its own worktree, and finished work is rebased onto main and pushed. No pull requests, because there is nobody to review them.
//states: The first rung needs no label: it is what an issue carrying none already is. There is no review rung, because nothing goes through review here.
//branch: Type prefixes come from the issue's own label, mapped onto a commit type so the branch and its commits agree. `#42` becomes `42` in the ref: a `#` in a branch name is a comment character in too many files to be worth it.
//delivery: rebase onto main, fast-forward, push, then remove the worktree and delete the branch. A rebase conflict aborts and reports rather than resolving itself.
notes: Add .worktrees/ to .gitignore — the installer writes only _dev-workflow/ and .claude/skills/dev-*, and will not touch it for you.
